newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares firm, brief correction seen.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares firm, brief correction seen.

text.p: Russian shares firmed in extremely thin trading on Tuesday, though traders said they expected a correction early next year.
At 1200 GMT the Russian Trading System 24-share index was at 199.52, up from Monday's 197.94 close.
About $1 million worth of shares traded on the RTS, which showed about eight leading, liquid shares or their related preferred stocks changing hands.
LUKoil rose to $11.49 from $11.30 at Monday's close on volume of 10,000 shares. Surgutneftegaz preferred firmed to $0.300 from $0.288 on 100,000 shares.
Dealers said a few buyers pushed up the market, and some said brokers inflated prices to make end-of-year profits appear stronger.

The share market will be closed January 1-4, open Sunday January 5 and Monday January 6, closed for Russian Orthodox Christmas on January 7 and resume trading on January 8. Many anticipated a post-holiday correction after this.
"We'll see an initial supply of stock after the New Year which may lead to a correction, but that will be absorbed at these levels," said Troika-Dialog's Terry Olin.
